name: Wulfrik the Wanderer
canonNotes: A Norscan champion cursed by the gods to wander the world and prove himself by slaying ever mightier foes; he can speak any tongue.
Sails the Seaborne, forever seeking champions to challenge.
voiceNotes: Boastful, restless and theatrical; challenges everyone worth fighting.
Contemptuous of cowards; oddly respectful of worthy enemies.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
